title: Token economy — Ring Platform
description: How Ring’s three-layer economy works: reward credit balance, sponsored Solana native token (RING), Token Desk exchange, contribution rewards, membership, MicroDAO votes, and vendor KEYS NFT RWA.

hero.title: RING is a utility token
hero.subtitle: We do not presell it, and we invite you to step over crypto speculative greed. A new age is here: Ring clones run a three-layer economy — an off-chain reward credit balance, a sponsored Solana SPL native token for the on-chain wallet, and optional NFT / referral rails. Credits are fiat points (stable value without the absurdity); RING is the native token. Credits exchange for tokens at Token Desk.

layers.title: Three layers of own value
layers.subtitle: Your unsold products in ERP and purchased orders in CRM, user credit balance for refunds and rewards, and native token for NFT-gated access and long-term user loyalty. Set your own credits-to-currency and token-to-credits rates via brand oracle. Be your own Emperor.

credit.title: Reward credit balance
credit.description: credit_balance is denominated in your store’s default currency (USD on ring-platform.org). Members top up by card or PayPal, earn contribution rewards, and use credits for refunds, store checkout, generative media, and selected membership paths through PaymentConductor’s internal_credit rail.

native.title: Sponsored native SPL (RING)
native.description: RING is this clone’s Solana SPL utility token. Custodial wallets provision on sign-in. The treasury sponsors gas so members send and settle without holding SOL. Desk buys follow treasury_transfer policy: native tokens move from the clone treasury into member wallets.

rails.title: NFT RWA, MicroDAO, referrals
rails.description: Vendor KEYS gates are on-chain access certificates — tradeable deeds and licenses settled in RING. MicroDAO pools gather native-token contributions toward delivery. ReferralRewards is a dedicated growth rail that complements contribution credit rewards.

desk.title: Token Desk — credits ↔ RING
desk.subtitle: Subscriber+ exchanges credit points and native token at your live brand oracle. Desk conversion and everyday credit spend each keep their own clear rate path.

oracle.title: Brand oracle rates
oracle.description: Credits-to-currency uses credit.unitToDefaultCurrency (usually 1). Token-to-credits uses platform_settings.web3.oracle.ringPerUsd on Token Desk. You set both — your rates, your economy.

firstSettler.title: First-settler welcome
firstSettler.description: A configured first-settler discount (2000 bps / 20% on this clone) can apply once when wallet, username, date of birth, and verification gates are complete — a warm path into desk trades for finished profiles.

quotes.title: Signed quotes
quotes.description: Desk quotes carry TTL and max slippage. Members confirm; WalletConductor executeDesk validates the signature, moves treasury RING or credits the ledger, and records history.

rewards.title: How members earn credit rewards
rewards.subtitle: Real contribution awards credit points — idempotent, role-multiplied, and UTC daily-capped so the ledger stays fair and auditable.

profile.title: Profile & verification
profile.description: Published events reward username, bio, location, website, messengers, profile completion, and admin verification — once per user where configured.

contribution.title: Content & requests
contribution.description: Approved news stories, comments, reviews, and opportunity requests can award credits once per object. Subscriber+ roles begin earning; visitors grow into the economy by joining.

caps.title: Multipliers & daily caps
caps.description: Role multipliers (for example member 1.5×, confidential 2×) scale base amounts. Daily earn caps protect the UTC budget so rewards stay sustainable for the whole community.

membership.title: Membership
membership.description: SubscriptionConductor supports credit_balance, native_token (Solana RingMembership), card rails, and nft_gate. The on-chain reference fee is 1 RING per 30 days with grace handling — a clear, durable membership path.

store.title: Store & services
store.description: Checkout can debit credits or native token when enabled. Credits stay on the fiat ledger; native rails transfer SPL to treasury so ERP stock and CRM orders stay coherent with wallet truth.

send.title: P2P sends & contacts
send.description: Gasless custodial RING transfers to contacts or addresses. Treasury is fee payer; optional P2P tax is config-driven and kept distinct from desk sell tax.

dao.title: MicroDAO votes
dao.description: Public pools let communities like and chip in RING toward a shared goal. Admins and confidential operators create DAOs so priority is expressed with native-token commitment.

nftRwa.title: Vendor NFT RWA (KEYS)
nftRwa.subtitle: Metaplex Core gate NFTs sell for RING. Tradeable vendor deeds and licenses are access RWA: ownership moves on the Exhibition Marketplace; product features unlock after GateEscrow stake.

primary.title: Primary sale
primary.description: Buy on /nft/gates with RING transferChecked, then mint. Membership gates may be soulbound; vendor store-deed, DAGI, and license gates are tradeable when unstaked.

secondary.title: Secondary market
secondary.description: KEYS lane lists verified gates for RING. Purchase transfers ownership; stake so GateResolver grants product access. Member-lane collections celebrate ownership and creative minting on-platform.

why.title: Loyalty you can hold
why.description: Vendor access becomes a transferable certificate settled in your native token — marketplace liquidity tied to real unlocks, long-term loyalty, and the clone’s own brand economy.

utilityFirst.title: Utility-first
utilityFirst.description: The native token opens access and settles fees inside your ecosystem. Build lasting utility for members; keep speculative hype outside the product story.

cloneBranding.title: Per-clone branding
cloneBranding.description: Symbol and name come from ring-config (RING here; DAAR / DAARION on agricultural clones). UI uses getNativeTokenSymbol() so every surface speaks your brand.

ownOracle.title: Be your own Emperor
ownOracle.description: Treasury policy, desk supplyPolicy, referral queues, and brand oracle rates are yours to set. Credits-to-currency and token-to-credits answer to your clone — your rates, your realm.

step1.title: Sign in
step1.description: Custodial wallets provision automatically across enabled chains.

step2.title: Earn or top up credits
step2.description: Complete reward actions or add credits by card — then open Token Desk when you want on-chain RING.

step3.title: Settle where it matters
step3.description: Send to contacts, fund membership, vote in MicroDAO, or buy and stake vendor KEYS — with treasury-sponsored gas, no SOL required.

cta.title: Operate your clone economy
cta.subtitle: Open the wallet for Token Desk and balances, or read Token Economics setup to configure your brand oracle and rails.
